Phlebodium is a small genus that includes two species of ferns: Phileba (Pilea) and Phloridium (Pteridophorum). Both species belong to the same genus but have distinct characteristics and habitats. Phileba has broad leaves, whereas Phloridium has lanceolate leaves with bare sections below.
